title: Sprint 14 Mid-Sprint Check
raw_text:
Sarah: Quick update. Karim, how is the ORM migration going?

Karim: Slower than expected. I converted 40 of the 60 queries. The remaining 20 are complex joins that do not map cleanly to the ORM. I might need to keep some as raw SQL with proper wrappers.

Sarah: That is a pragmatic approach. Do what makes sense. Do not force everything into the ORM if it makes the code worse.

Karim: Understood. I should be done by May 2 as planned, but the result will be 80 percent ORM and 20 percent wrapped raw SQL.

Sarah: That is acceptable.

Youssef: The search prototype is working. Basic text search across all entities. It is rough but functional.

Sarah: Good. We should probably add filters to it at some point. And maybe autocomplete. But that is for later.

Youssef: Should I keep working on it or stop here?

Sarah: Keep polishing it a bit. But do not spend too much time. We have other things coming up.

Youssef: How much time is not too much?

Sarah: Use your judgment. A couple of days maybe. Let us talk about it next week.

Sarah: Anything else? Good. Meeting closed.
